content_sections.heading: BAVMC Pune Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Overview
BAVMC Pune Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the BAVMC Pune Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download BAVMC Pune Assistant Professor Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post offered in the BAVMC Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The BAVMC Pune is recruiting for the post of Assistant Professor (Community Medicine - UHTC).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Professor (Community Medicine - UHTC) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 17 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q6. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Original Interview Schedule Publication Date is 03 September 2026, and the Interview Date is 17 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location is Pune, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is 11201.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to submit an application form before the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates are advised to check the official notification for details on whether a duly filled application form is required to be carried to the interview venue.
